title: AERODECK / Toolbox2 deep comparison
overlapWarning: Rows include overlapping data,UI,control and configuration contracts. Do not sum as independent features or derive parity%.

rows.toolbox: AHR and ATT fill sky then call X.HR, aliased to lcd.drawHudRectangle.
rows.aerodeck: Cockpit fills sky then calls the same native lcd.drawHudRectangle, with overlay scales.
rows.userImpact: The base attitude field uses the same radio rendering primitive. Primitive versus bitmap alone does not establish superiority.
rows.acceptance: Match native field orientation at level, ±20° pitch, ±35° and ±90° bank and inverted on target radio.

rows.feature: CRSF pitch sign and angle units
rows.toolbox: TBS GYRO converts radians to degrees and negates pitch only; roll/yaw retain sign.
rows.aerodeck: read(...,pitch) negates radians pitch; roll/yaw convert without negation. Degree sources are accepted as already normalized.
rows.userImpact: A sign error would invert climb/descent cues. The CRSF transform matches in code.
rows.acceptance: On the same quad physically verify level, nose-up/down, right/left bank and inverted. Separately verify degree-unit inputs are normalized by their producer.

rows.toolbox: Native HUD receives unrounded D.S.ATT_PITCH/ROLL; numeric captions are floored separately.
rows.aerodeck: Native HUD receives current unrounded values. Overlay uses sin(roll)*pitch and cos(roll)*pitch*1.85 with datum(240,154), matching native 2.12.4 projection.
rows.userImpact: Matching field and overlaid ladder projection prevents a sliding datum error.
rows.acceptance: At every pose, ensure native horizon, zero rung and aircraft datum remain coincident where applicable; include ±90° and ±180°.

rows.toolbox: Original AHR computes pitch-dependent RGB: ground(20,235−1.5 s,20), sky(45+1.5 s,45+1.5 s,255), with s=min(floor(abs(pitch)),90). ATT uses theme sky/ground colors.
rows.aerodeck: Current full app uses fixed sky#2070 a 6 and ground#755831 plus contrast lines. Both apps distinguish sky from ground; exact gradients are optional visual choices.
rows.userImpact: Both distinguish sky/ground; exact colors and textures are optional aesthetic choices.
rows.acceptance: At 30–40 cm outdoors verify distinguishable field orientation through all poses, including color-vision variation. Do not require copying Toolbox colors.

rows.toolbox: AHR caches DBD_AHL.png, a 30×6 RGBA aircraft marker. ATT has dotted fixed horizontal reference.
rows.aerodeck: 88 px orange aircraft wings with black halo and 6 px center datum; fixed over moving field.
rows.userImpact: A larger datum is present; functional improvement depends on viewing-distance and pose readability, not drawing method.
rows.acceptance: Read datum immediately at 30–40 cm; preserve zero alignment and avoid ladder-caption collisions in bank/inverted flight.

rows.toolbox: Original AHR draws native horizon, aircraft, speed/altitude tapes and numerical P/R; no pitch-rung drawing loop or ladder bitmap. ATT tick ring is fixed angular perimeter.
rows.aerodeck: 10° rungs within±40° of pitch,20° signed SMLSIZE labels, zero horizon emphasized; clips transformed rungs to inner field.
rows.userImpact: Adds quantitative pitch reference to the attitude view.
rows.acceptance: Verify signed 20° labels and 10° rungs at normal/bank 35/pitch 10/90 bank/inverted; labels must stay separate and never obscure datum.

rows.toolbox: AHR and ATT show numerical pitch/roll; ATT names each value.
rows.aerodeck: Persistent P/R signed degree readouts at upper cockpit corners; uses current values.
rows.userImpact: Quantitative angle reading remains available despite removal of circular bezel.
rows.acceptance: Native fonts must remain readable and fit±180° without crossing field/heading or ladder labels.

rows.toolbox: ATT foreground 108×109 JPEG mask supplies circular tick marks; ring is static, yaw dot is separate.
rows.aerodeck: No circular graduated reference or bank pointer. Numeric roll and ladder/field provide angle information, but equivalence of the graduated angular reference is not proven.
rows.userImpact: Reading a number is a different perceptual task from judging orientation against a graduated reference.
rows.acceptance: Provide an equally effective graduated angular reference in the AERODECK design, or demonstrate same-radio bank-direction/magnitude recognition at least as good as Toolbox. Exact circular bezel artwork is not required.

rows.toolbox: ATT shows numerical YAW and a radius 47 green point when yaw exists.
rows.aerodeck: Yaw is available numerically on Telemetry; full Flight compass is GPS course Hdg, not yaw.
dependencies: Yaw source distinct from GPS course
rows.userImpact: Stationary aircraft orientation cannot be inferred from course-over-ground.
rows.acceptance: Provide an explicitly labeled yaw/heading orientation option or separate display without silently substituting GPS course.

rows.toolbox: ATT draws native rectangle through cached background aperture/foreground masks; AHR is rectangular.
rows.aerodeck: Rectangular cockpit with opaque side tapes; moving rungs and extra horizon line clipped numerically inside intended field. No cockpit image decode on warm draw.
rows.userImpact: Both constrain moving field to a designated instrument region.
rows.acceptance: No field/rung/caption escapes its view at 45 pose combinations and extreme angle limits; native radio verification still required.

rows.toolbox: AHR/ATT native calls fallback to 0 when an attitude component is nil; dashboard also dims telemetry-off elements. Exact recovered dim conditions are malformed and not trusted.
rows.aerodeck: Both pitch and roll must be current and valid; otherwise ATTITUDE UNAVAILABLE, no synthetic level field.
rows.userImpact: Explicit unavailable state avoids displaying invented level flight.
rows.acceptance: Unplug/replug telemetry and individual Ptch/Roll sources; no stale or fabricated level attitude may appear as live.

rows.toolbox: Original AHR chooses airspeed if present, otherwise ground speed; when airspeed is primary, ground speed can be auxiliary.
rows.aerodeck: Flight tape is fixed GS from d.speed; ASpd appears only in Telemetry.
rows.userImpact: A fixed-wing pilot loses airspeed-primary flight presentation although data is sampled.
rows.acceptance: Selectable/automatic airspeed-primary tape with explicit AS/GS labels and simultaneous ground-speed context when available.

rows.toolbox: Original AHR chooses GPS altitude then barometric altitude; supports auxiliary barometric altitude while GPS is primary.
rows.aerodeck: read tries GAlt then Alt into one d.alt; Flight always labels ALT and cannot show both simultaneously or state provenance.
rows.userImpact: The user cannot distinguish an altitude-source fallback or compare sources in Flight.
rows.acceptance: Select/label GPS ASL vs barometric/relative altitude and optionally show secondary altitude; exercise source loss and recovery.

rows.feature: Speed tape ticks and selected value
rows.toolbox: AHR has 7 major positions around selected index, speed 5-unit major spacing with quarter minor ticks and 24 px selection box.
rows.aerodeck: GS km/h equal-width side tape,10-unit ticks with 2.4 px/unit;29 px selected value and fitting.
rows.userImpact: Both provide trend/context and exact selected speed; range conventions differ.
rows.acceptance: Verify zero, low, very high speeds, negative-invalid inputs and long values without partial digits or mislabeled units.

rows.feature: Altitude tape ticks and selected value
rows.toolbox: AHR altitude 50-unit major spacing with minor ticks and 24 px selected box.
rows.aerodeck: ALT m 10-unit ticks at 2.4 px/unit; negative altitude allowed, selected 29 px value fits 38 px.
rows.userImpact: Different scale spacing is a usability choice, not automatic superiority.
rows.acceptance: Check below-sea-level, zero, hundreds/thousands and >five digits; keep selected value distinct from moving labels.

rows.toolbox: AHR shows GPS ground course, optional home bearing; secondary CMP displays course dot against cardinal circle.
rows.aerodeck: Full-width 30 px compass band, heading 29 px badge;15° ticks/30° labels,cardinals and wrap 360.
rows.userImpact: AERODECK preserves ground-course awareness in a different encoding.
rows.acceptance: At 359→0 and headings 15/140 avoid clipped/hidden labels and badge overlap; clearly identify course rather than magnetic heading.

rows.toolbox: AHR can show relative home H marker or offscale arrow and home distance/course context. CMP can show separate home/course points.
rows.aerodeck: Flight footer displays local home distance only; home bearing is on GPS Details/Track page, not projected into cockpit.
rows.userImpact: Returning toward home requires leaving Flight or remembering bearing.
rows.acceptance: Add concise direction-to-home cue with explicit home validity and relative/absolute semantics, preserving full compass readability.

rows.toolbox: TBS GYRO conversion returns sensor value; AHR passes latest values to native HUD. No smoothing filter is proven in those modules.
rows.aerodeck: No interpolation/smoothing in read/poll/cockpit; latest current values rendered.
rows.userImpact: Draw FPS cannot make stale telemetry move smoothly without inventing samples.
rows.acceptance: Record incoming Ptch/Roll timestamps, change cadence and on-screen latency over>=10 minutes under identical link settings; no slowdown after launch.

rows.toolbox: ML.run services MSP/bg and then SN_ATT/SN_BARO/SN_AIR/GPS before UI tasks; task drawing has no explicit per-HUD FPS limiter in UITSKRUN.
rows.aerodeck: pollAttitude runs before throttle and again in sample; full sample/render gated by ceil(100/renderHz), default 25 fps.
dependencies: Telemetry transport including MSP side effects
rows.userImpact: Same native HUD does not ensure same update behavior; source and loop lifecycle matter.
rows.acceptance: On TX 16 S 2.12.4 A/B Toolbox/current app with same model,link,quad: stable draw/value-changeHz, p 95 latency, worst frame stall, memory trend. Desktop WASM is not hardware proof.

rows.toolbox: User observation says Toolbox remains responsive on the same radio. Source proves lifecycle, not measured speed.
rows.aerodeck: In-memory diagnostics separate drawfps and value-changeHz; no SD loop logging. Current release manifest explicitly has hardwarePerformanceMeasured=false.
rows.userImpact: The original user-reported degradation cannot be declared solved by screenshots or constant draw FPS.
rows.acceptance: Same-radio>=10 minute comparison including launch,2 s,1 min,10 min and telemetry reconnect; no progressive stall and value latency at least Toolbox baseline.

rows.toolbox: RCL dashboard has two signal gauges, transmitter-power and RF context backed by generic sensor mappings.
rows.aerodeck: Left Flight rail shows LQ,RSSI,SNR 29 px,Txpower 17 px with units and thresholds.
rows.userImpact: Core link signal values are visible without leaving cockpit.
rows.acceptance: Verify actual mappings,diversity receiver and low/critical limits; missing values muted rather than green.

rows.toolbox: RDB dashboard reads SN 01 transmitter battery value/percent and warning colors.
rows.aerodeck: Flight contains model pack voltage only; no transmitter battery measurement/display in main.
rows.userImpact: The pilot loses radio power context while fullscreen.
rows.acceptance: Display compact transmitter battery warning/value with distinct identity from aircraft pack; respect radio warning configuration.

rows.toolbox: BAT dashboard uses voltage,current,remaining/consumed charge with unit-aware gauges.
rows.aerodeck: Right Flight rail shows pack voltage,percent,USEDmAh,current and derived average cell voltage.
rows.userImpact: Core battery state is visible in Flight; zero and missing are distinct.
rows.acceptance: Real quad validate voltage/current against EdgeTX native telemetry,including 0 A and current stale separately from voltage.

rows.toolbox: BTC conditionally renders actual per-cell values using BT_MD_CELLS_V/BT_MD_CELL_V. CEL shows cell count..S, not the cell array. MPN exposes BTC when array data exists. No BTC/CEL minimum, maximum or delta calculation is proven. Native CRSF per-cell feed from the connected Betaflight/ELRS quad is unverified.
rows.aerodeck: Only derived pack-average cell voltage is displayed; no individual-cell-array reader/presentation.
dependencies: An actual cell-array source from a supported backend
Connected Betaflight/ELRS native CRSF feed unverified
rows.userImpact: Average voltage can hide a weak individual cell, but no renderer can invent genuine per-cell readings from pack voltage.
rows.acceptance: Parity: conditionally display actual reported individual-cell values and a clear no-cell-data state. Never fabricate cell readings from pack average. Proposed improvement: minimum, maximum and delta, explicitly additional rather than claimed Toolbox behavior.
rows.backendAvailability: Unverified for connected Betaflight/ELRS native CRSF
rows.proposedImprovement: Measured minimum/maximum cell voltage and spread from an actual reported array.

rows.toolbox: TIM dashboard draws YYYY-MM-DD and HH:MM from getDateTime.
rows.aerodeck: Global header shows HH:MM cached 1 s; no date display.
rows.userImpact: Time remains available but calendar date is absent.
rows.acceptance: Make date available in a small context/diagnostic view; handle missing RTC without fabricated date.

rows.toolbox: TMR reads selected model.getTimer; supports arm-hosted model timer with start/stop in ML.bg.
rows.aerodeck: Session flightSeconds derives mapped RADIO ARM only while full app runs; rendered on ArmInfo footer, not Flight. No model.getTimer.
rows.userImpact: Elapsed flight time can reset or diverge when leaving the app; it does not replace the radio timer.
rows.acceptance: Read configured model timer; show value/running state in Flight. If optional arm hosting implemented, honor start/stop/reset semantics without silently editing timer ownership.

rows.toolbox: FM dashboard displays current flight mode and arm-state styling.
rows.aerodeck: Global footer displays d.flight; long string fitted to 104 px, currentness required.
rows.userImpact: Flight mode remains accessible on most screens unless higher-priority warning replaces footer.
rows.acceptance: Verify ANGLE/HORIZON/ACRO with arm marker and long FM without clipping; unknown must remain explicit.

rows.toolbox: FMI dashboard has independent IND_AM,IND_RTH,IND_TU icons with priority rules.
rows.aerodeck: No dedicated airmode,RTH,turtle indicator presentation; only FM string and radioArm/radioCut in ArmInfo.
rows.userImpact: Important secondary modes may not appear in generic FM text.
rows.acceptance: Show distinct validated Airmode,RTH/Turtle states with unknown/off/on semantics and no reliance on arbitrary FM substring guesses.

rows.toolbox: THR dashboard panel renders throttle channel percent, cut and configured throttle-limit indication.
rows.aerodeck: No live throttle/limit display. Radio cut is mapped and shown as ON/OFF/-- only in ArmInfo.
rows.userImpact: Pilot cannot inspect throttle output/limit while using Flight.
rows.acceptance: Present normalized actual throttle,cut and limit with clear source/configuration semantics; do not label stick input as motor output.

rows.toolbox: VTX dashboard includes type/source,channel/frequency,power,LPD/PIT state and condition colors.
rows.aerodeck: No live VTX fields on Flight or Video; eight saved frequencies are local notes only.
rows.userImpact: Saved notes cannot confirm actual transmitting channel/power/pit mode.
rows.acceptance: Read actual VTX configuration/status; distinguish reported,pending,confirmed and unavailable values, including PIT/LPD.

rows.toolbox: Model dashboard banner warns arming disabled; Arm Stops module shows reported reasons.
rows.aerodeck: Global footer shows first reason+remaining count, stale/error/unknown states and persistent shield action to explanation/check view.
dependencies: Validated status decoder and fresh disarmed MSP
rows.userImpact: Arming failure is inspectable from any screen,including warnings.
rows.acceptance: Touch/rotary activation from Flight/GPS/Setup returns to origin,retains drafts;API/count unknown must not be misnamed; verify targetFC/radio.

rows.toolbox: SYS represents mspFcReady, mspReady and mspTxReady with a condition-colored MSP indicator. Mute and input-lock are assessed separately in ui-flight-13.
rows.aerodeck: Diagnostics/Setup show transport status including STARTING, IDENTIFYING, WAITING, READY, timeout and TX BUSY. Arm Info separately reports reply freshness. Normal footer intentionally omits MSP link text.
rows.userImpact: Connection/readiness/backpressure information is available with a different hierarchy; this row does not imply mute/lock parity.
rows.acceptance: Under unavailable, unsupported, timeout and transmit backpressure states, show an accurate diagnostic status and recover without flooding. Never display NO FLAGS without a valid reply.

rows.toolbox: SYS displays mute and widget/no-input lock symbols.
rows.aerodeck: No mute toggle/state icon or input-lock icon in app; compact widget contains no controls.
dependencies: Audio/haptic lifecycle and widget input availability
rows.userImpact: User cannot quickly silence app alerts or see that interaction is unavailable.
rows.acceptance: Provide app-level mute with visible state and clear scope; disabled widget interactions must be recognizable.

rows.toolbox: TLM dashboard shows telem quality/off state and dims relevant fields. Module chrome retains left/right signal/battery indicators.
rows.aerodeck: Global red footer when no current telemetry or configured battery/link warning; no-data field states and Diagnostics target.
rows.userImpact: Loss/warning is globally visible,though normal footer content is replaced.
rows.acceptance: Exercise partial source loss and full loss; warnings should identify cause without erasing Arm action or misleading still-current fields.

rows.toolbox: Toolbox module shell retains RC and model-battery vertical sidebars around Telemetry,GPS,VTX,Config,ArmStops,Sticks.
rows.aerodeck: Outside Flight/Data/Power/RC pages,normal footer has FM,home distance,sats,arming flags; no always-visible pack voltage or link quality except alerts.
rows.userImpact: Critical alerts remain, but continuous pack/link glance values disappear on GPS/Setup/Tools/Video.
rows.acceptance: Keep essential pack/link health legible on every screen or prove threshold-only status achieves the same monitoring tasks; avoid duplicate wasted data.

rows.toolbox: Toolbox dashboard scales the model bitmap from /IMAGES and shows model name unless arming blocker overlay.
rows.aerodeck: Global header model name fitted 54 px atTINSIZE; no model image.
rows.userImpact: Long names can become hard to distinguish; decorative model bitmap itself need not be copied.
rows.acceptance: Provide reliably distinguishable active model identity/full name on demand before operation; optional image is aesthetic,not required.

rows.toolbox: Main selector cycles FCD/AHR/battery/VTXfavourites depending sources; secondary cycles attitude,compass,GPS,position; bottom cycles throttle/MSP/memory.
rows.aerodeck: Flight is one fixed PFD; related information is in stable sections/context pages.
rows.userImpact: Functional information can be equivalent without copying the multiplexed layout, but missing alternate capabilities still count.
rows.acceptance: Every conditional Toolbox panel task must have an intuitive AERODECK destination; offer sensible configurable Flight priorities without requiring hidden cycling.

rows.toolbox: GPS module displays latitude/longitude with 7 decimals; dashboard GPS shows 6.
rows.aerodeck: GPS Details 7 decimals;Track 6; validates finite/range and accepts valid 0,0.
rows.userImpact: Position remains inspectable with equal displayed precision.
rows.acceptance: Test hemispheres,±180/±90,0,0,current/stale/invalid tables and native column fit; never substitute missing coordinate 0.

rows.toolbox: GPS module shows speed,ASL altitude and aircraft course with units.
rows.aerodeck: GPS Details speedkm/h,altm,GPScourse; generic alt fallback may become barometric without relabeling.
rows.userImpact: A value may be current yet have ambiguous altitude semantics.
rows.acceptance: Keep GPS ASL provenance explicit; show unavailable if only relative/barometric altitude exists,or relabel source clearly.

rows.toolbox: GPS header/dashboard shows satellite count plus available detailed count when present.
rows.aerodeck: GPS Details large count and global satellite icon+count.
rows.userImpact: Basic satellite count is present.
rows.acceptance: Verify actual count from quad without inferring fix merely from a nonzero count.

rows.toolbox: GPS UI labels POS_FIX as 3 D FIX. Original TBS/CRSF backend defines POS_FIX=Sats>GPS_SATS 2 FIX, not an actual FC fix report. Other backend fix fields require separate verification.
rows.aerodeck: GPS Details truthfully says FIX TYPE NOT REPORTED. Local home gating uses count+valid coordinate, not an actual FC fix.
dependencies: Actual FC/GNSS fix source where available
Explicit distinction between reported and estimated fix
rows.userImpact: Nonzero satellite count does not prove a usable fix. Copying the Toolbox count heuristic as 3 D FIX would be misleading.
rows.acceptance: Read reliable actual no-fix/2 D/3 D state with source freshness where supported. If only a count heuristic exists, label it estimated and retain actual fix UNKNOWN.

rows.toolbox: GPS dashboard displays GPS_HDOP numeric/gauge. Original TBS backend sets it to clamp(Sats−4,0,9) when its count-based fix is true; that is not measured HDOP. Other backends may supply real quality.
rows.aerodeck: No HDOP data or display.
rows.userImpact: An HDOP-looking gauge can mislead if its input is merely satellite count.
rows.acceptance: Show genuine reported HDOP/quality when available. Otherwise report unsupported/unknown or a clearly labeled count estimate; do not implement fake HDOP to imitate the screenshot.

rows.toolbox: GPS module enumerates GPS/SBAS/Galileo/BeiDou/IMES/QZSS/Glonass and satellite ID,10 rows scroll.
rows.aerodeck: Left GPS card contains satellite count/fix-not-reported/local-home state only; no list.
rows.userImpact: The user requested the expanding satellite/config information; count alone is not parity.
rows.acceptance: Provide scrollable per-satellite identity/constellation where FC receiver/protocol supports it; explicit unsupported otherwise.

rows.feature: Per-satellite signal, quality-derived status and use
rows.toolbox: Original satellite handling plus GPS UI prove constellation/ID, quality-derived status, used-state and signal presentation. A SAT_HEAL name table exists, but an independently supplied/displayed satellite-health field is not established.
rows.aerodeck: No per-satellite quality/signal/status/use display. Independent health remains an unknown backend dependency, not a proven extra value to fabricate.
rows.userImpact: The app cannot show searching/lock/use/signal detail. Satellite health must not be inferred from signal or a declared unused name table.
rows.acceptance: Implement the source-proven identity/quality/status/use/signal fields from actual backend data, with scrolling and explicit unsupported states. Add independent health only when a real field and semantics are established.

rows.toolbox: GPS module displays home LAT/LON,distance and heading; TBS backend records home around fix/armed transition.
rows.aerodeck: Local manual/auto home,home coordinates,haversine distance and bearing; explicitly LOCAL HOME.
rows.userImpact: Current local reference is useful but not necessarily FC Rescue home.
rows.acceptance: Distinguish FC-reported rescue home from app-local reference; verify arm/fix transitions,disarm/rearm,telemetry reconnect and manual reset.

rows.toolbox: TBS GPS routine maintains home/fix/armed state as telemetry is serviced globally.
rows.aerodeck: Auto home first captures inside navSnapshot,which runs only while GPS Details/Track render; count threshold not actual fix/arm transition.
rows.userImpact: Opening GPS later can capture a different location than takeoff. Flight footer distance stays unavailable until local home exists.
rows.acceptance: Capture chosen home semantics in shared telemetry state independent of which page is viewed; preserve clear manual override and source label.

rows.feature: Home bearing versus aircraft course cue
rows.toolbox: CMP shows two independently positioned points; AHR can show relative home cue.
rows.aerodeck: GPS Details numericalbearing/course; Track rotates aircraft triangle by course,home at origin. No cockpit relative-home pointer.
rows.userImpact: Navigation tasks require page context; numeric bearing alone is less glanceable in Flight.
rows.acceptance: A distinct direction-to-home cue must remain meaningful with stationary/unknown course; do not equate course and yaw.

rows.toolbox: POS draws clamped relative lat/lon plane icon around home; no map imagery.
rows.aerodeck: North-up metric plot with distance rings,threezoom levels,clipped bounded trail,home and heading triangle.
rows.userImpact: Adds metric spatial context rather than a decorative map.
rows.acceptance: Verify latitude scaling/haversinebearing,zoom distance labels,dateline,large distances,offplot arrow/state and stale trail distinction.

rows.toolbox: POS displays ETHh/m/s from POS_TIMEH; GPS helper calculates travel time with distance/speed units.
rows.aerodeck: No ETH calculation/display.
rows.userImpact: Pilot loses approximate return-time context.
rows.acceptance: Provide explicitly estimated time with assumptions; unavailable at zero/unknown speed; do not call it wind-aware return capability.

rows.toolbox: GPS helper stores bounded positions with date,time,ostime; deduplicates unchanged coordinates. Persistence/export not proven by this helper alone.
rows.aerodeck: navTrack stores onlylat/lon every 1 s while GPS page renders,cap 10..180; no timestamps/movementdedup.
dependencies: GPS logging setting and shared sampler
rows.userImpact: Track history does not cover periods spent on Flight and cannot show age/time of lastknown location.
rows.acceptance: Log bounded timestamped current coordinates independently of selected page; label age of the last known point. Test stationary deduplication and stale/reconnect behavior.

rows.toolbox: GPSINIT implements encodeToPlusCode. This is code capability; a user-facing invocation was not found in inspected UI files.
rows.aerodeck: No Plus Code encoder or display.
rows.userImpact: A source-proven recovery-format capability is absent,though Toolbox UI exposure is not proven.
rows.acceptance: Independently implement standards-valid Plus Code and expose it where useful for recovery; test official vectors. Do not claim Toolbox user-facing parity without identifying its caller.

rows.toolbox: GPS helper observed history is in memory; inspected code does not itself prove SD persistence.
rows.aerodeck: Home/track/lastpoint are session-local; closing/reopening resets them.
rows.userImpact: Do not promise recovery after restart from either in-memory implementation.
rows.acceptance: Trace Toolbox log writers/readers before grading persistence. Separately define and verify AERODECK last-known coordinate retention and power-loss behavior.

rows.toolbox: Toolbox GPS supports satellite-row scrolling, returns to dashboard, and displays MSP information.
rows.aerodeck: Refresh Sensors, Set Local Home and Track Zoom with disabled-home handling; stale coordinates remove current position while an old trail may remain.
rows.userImpact: Own navigation controls can be equivalent without copying Toolbox buttons.
rows.acceptance: Touch and rotary reach every enabled control. Verify stale→live transitions and RTN parent behavior; no Set Home from stale/invalid position.

rows.toolbox: Toolbox MOD/TLM defines a grouped live telemetry table with units and backend-specific rows.
rows.aerodeck: Three columns with nine rows each: RC link, flight data, attitude/GPS. Values come from a shared sample with units, -- and measured fitting.
dependencies: Mapped sources and correct conversion semantics
rows.userImpact: Broad raw-data inspection is available in the AERODECK design.
rows.acceptance: Map every Toolbox sensor row to an equivalent destination and actual unit/provenance. A nominal 27 rows is not proof of all backend sensor support.

rows.toolbox: Toolbox battery/telemetry panels show configured battery values and condition states.
rows.aerodeck: Power adds bounded 90-sample histories at 1 Hz, OFF/NOT FOUND/STALE/INVALID explanations and Sources/Refresh/Limits actions.
rows.userImpact: Provides actionable diagnosis of voltage/current availability.
rows.acceptance: Match native telemetry currentness, explicit None, late binding, genuine zero and per-model profiles. Never fabricate full battery when consumption is missing.

rows.toolbox: Dashboard/module sidebars expose RC quality, power and RF data.
rows.aerodeck: RC Link cards and bounded 90-sample LQ plot; Telemetry also exposes downlink quality and second receiver RSSI.
rows.userImpact: Both support link inspection; AERODECK history provides extra context.
rows.acceptance: Verify actual aliases/units for ELRS and supported FrSky/FC backends. Long values must fit; missing values must not look healthy.

rows.toolbox: VFV displays the configured favourite frequency grid.
rows.aerodeck: Eight local frequency cards with known-band channel derivation, CUSTOM fallback and per-model editing.
rows.userImpact: Saved reference frequencies are useful but separate from actual VTX state.
rows.acceptance: Persist all eight values; fit CUSTOM/channel/frequency labels. A selected note must not imply it is the active transmitter channel.

rows.toolbox: VFV rotary selection plus long ENTER calls SN_VTX(send,frequency,band,channel) when telemetry is on and the VTX is settable/ready.
rows.aerodeck: Reference selection only; explicit LOCAL NOTES / NO VTX COMMANDS, with no apply action.
dependencies: Supported VTX transport and state/capability gates
rows.userImpact: AERODECK cannot change actual VTX frequency. This key-gated functional capability remains required.
rows.acceptance: Independently implement guarded read, validate, apply, acknowledgement and refresh on each supported FC/receiver protocol. Distinguish unknown support and failed/pending/confirmed state.

rows.toolbox: AST displays arming-disabled status/reasons; exact API mapping is covered by the decoder audit.
rows.aerodeck: Arm Info has version/count-gated reasons, explanation/check text and scrolling; unknown flags remain numbered, stale/error status is explicit.
rows.userImpact: Preserves the arming diagnosis task in its own layout.
rows.acceptance: Every supported reason maps correctly; unknown API/count remains numbered. All reason lengths and touch/rotary scrolling must fit.

rows.toolbox: STK has FC-specific stick-command lists and radio stick-mode context.
rows.aerodeck: Betaflight reference only:12 commands over two pages, manual Mode 1..4 selector, paired 18 px diagrams and FC-support caveat.
dependencies: Correct FC type and actual radio stick mode
rows.userImpact: Betaflight reference exists, but other FC variants and automatic mode selection are not proven equivalent.
rows.acceptance: Trace and map every Toolbox FC-specific command list. Read actual radio mode or make the override explicit. Check commands against current primary FC documentation.

rows.toolbox: Configuration categories expand conditionally with capabilities/settings.
rows.aerodeck: Twelve categories with conditional visibility, draft/save/cancel, scrolling and source choices. The separate configuration audit owns field parity.
rows.userImpact: Equal category count does not prove equal settings or functions.
rows.acceptance: Every useful Toolbox setting, including key-gated function behavior, needs working UI and backend. Explain unsupported hardware dependencies explicitly.

rows.toolbox: Telemetry and source configuration use the Toolbox sensor registry.
rows.aerodeck: Tools/Sensors enumerates model sensor 0..63 in five-row pages with current/stale status and refresh. New telemetry discovery remains in EdgeTX.
rows.userImpact: Allows mapping diagnosis without claiming to configure the FC.
rows.acceptance: Expose ID/unit/instance where needed for duplicate-source troubleshooting. Refresh must preserve drafts and use actual qualified sources.

rows.toolbox: MEM displays current/max KB. SYS displays connection, mute and input lock.
rows.aerodeck: Diagnostics shows EdgeTX/build/model, source, MSP, FC/API, writes unavailable, background, draw FPS and value-change Hz; no heap KB.
rows.userImpact: Useful diagnostics exist, but draw FPS alone cannot establish stream latency or memory stability.
rows.acceptance: Show current/high-water Lua heap if available; measure warm cost, memory and sample age without per-frame SD writes.

rows.toolbox: ABT provides app/support information. Activation mechanism is excluded, while useful informational functions remain in scope.
rows.aerodeck: Build and FC/API appear in Diagnostics; no dedicated About/help/support destination.
dependencies: Support metadata and readable full identity
rows.userImpact: Version identification exists; self-service explanation/troubleshooting is limited.
rows.acceptance: Provide build, target capabilities, help and source/provenance without activation machinery. Make complete model/firmware identity readable on demand.

rows.toolbox: MODMENU caches 30 px module icons. SYS enters selection, rotary/ENTER chooses, RTN cancels or returns to dashboard; focused caption explains the target.
rows.aerodeck: Six persistent 30 px section icons with selected plate/underline; SYS focus shows caption, rotary/ENTER/RTN navigate. Home returns to Flight.
dependencies: Real EdgeTX event constants and physical mappings
rows.userImpact: AERODECK uses its own hierarchy; icon recognition is not universally guaranteed.
rows.acceptance: First-time users can find Flight, Data, GPS, Video, Setup and Tools by touch or SYS focus without memorization; selected/focused states remain distinct.

rows.toolbox: Dashboard PAGE events cycle main/secondary panels. Modules have local selection and quick-menu events.
rows.aerodeck: PAGE± cycles six stable section roots. Normal rotary focuses visible local controls; ENTER activates the focused target.
rows.userImpact: Equivalent tasks need not copy dashboard multiplexing.
rows.acceptance: Physical SYS, PAGE±, rotary, ENTER and RTN reach every destination with no invisible action or invalid-event collision.

rows.toolbox: Module header names the current page and presents the primary menu; dashboard subpanels switch independently.
rows.aerodeck: Data has three local tabs, GPS two and Tools three. Arm Info exposes Instruments/Arm Info tabs; Flight itself hides those tabs and uses its compass band. The global footer still renders on both. Setup uses category context; Video has a REFERENCE label.
rows.userImpact: Related tasks are grouped;12 destinations remain the complete current page inventory.
rows.acceptance: Touch/key targets match painted rectangles. On Arm Info, Instruments returns to Flight; Flight uses the persistent footer Arm shortcut. Selected contexts and global footer remain legible, including SYS-focus cancellation.

rows.toolbox: Arm Stops is reachable from menu and dashboard arming warning.
rows.aerodeck: Persistent 48×26 footer action on all 12 pages. RTN returns to origin, including Setup edit/draft; warnings retain the shortcut.
rows.userImpact: Arming diagnosis is reachable without losing the current task.
rows.acceptance: Touch and ENTER from Flight, GPS and Setup editor under normal, warning and stale/error states; RTN preserves selection and draft.

rows.toolbox: Warning conditions use condition colors, dim treatments and dialogs.
rows.aerodeck: Global warning targets Power, RC Link or Diagnostics. Exit modal has highest priority; invalid alert focus is cleared before body rendering.
rows.userImpact: Warnings are actionable and should not leave keyboard focus invisible after clearing.
rows.acceptance: While Setup alert is focused, clear the warning: category highlight and ENTER must recover in the same frame. Alert and Arm touch targets remain distinct.

rows.toolbox: Configuration owns save/exit interactions; exact parity is covered by the configuration audit.
rows.aerodeck: RTN on Flight with drafts opens Keep Editing/Discard Exit. Setup RTN cancels editor before leaving category/list.
rows.userImpact: Avoids silent loss while preserving predictable return paths.
rows.acceptance: Test edit→cancel, save failure, keep editing, discard exit and origin return via touch and keys. No settings write before explicit save.

rows.toolbox: QM fullscreen overlay is registered after OV at priority 0. Its exact action inventory needs caller tracing.
rows.aerodeck: No separate quick-action overlay; section navigation and footer remain available.
rows.userImpact: Actions may be available elsewhere, but quick-menu function coverage is not yet proven.
rows.acceptance: Map every Toolbox quick-menu action, including key-gated functions. Implement useful actions with clear state and few steps, without copying the skin.

rows.toolbox: X.LMK opens a bitmap and converts it to a mask; T.i and MENU cache masks.
rows.aerodeck: Twenty native RGB PNG masks: seven 30 px nav and thirteen 18 px detail/footer glyphs. Successes and failures are cached.
rows.userImpact: Both cache small glyphs, avoiding warm per-frame decode.
rows.acceptance: Each asset opens/converts no more than once per app lifetime. Missing assets use fallback without crash/white box; warm draw performs no SD I/O.

rows.toolbox: AHR uses a 30×6 RGBA aircraft. ATT uses 108×109 RGB JPEG foreground ticks and 108×110 aperture; CMP has 108×110 cardinal mask.
rows.aerodeck: Current Flight uses native HUD plus lines/text, no cockpit bitmap. Icons use cached masks.
dependencies: Source-bound asset dimensions and execution references
rows.userImpact: Different construction methods do not alone establish speed or clarity.
rows.acceptance: Compare functional cues, measured performance and actual native colors; verify all poses clip cleanly.

rows.toolbox: Themes have full-resolution overlay PNGs plus cached small functional masks.
rows.aerodeck: Thirty-nine packaged runtime files include 33 PNGs:20 current icon masks and 13 retained legacy panel/status images, not opened by current main.
dependencies: Release manifest and runtime reference inventory
rows.userImpact: Legacy package size does not imply current draw or decode cost.
rows.acceptance: Distinguish referenced, shipped and retained files. Any removal needs an explicit compatibility plan; this audit performs no cleanup.

rows.toolbox: Packaged raster assets/theme chunks were inspected; no editable vector origins were proven for these masks.
rows.aerodeck: Editable MaterialOutlined original/master SVGs, assets.json, source URLs, modification notices and native PNG exports are stored in development/icons/material.
rows.userImpact: Actual AERODECK glyphs have editable origins without copying Toolbox artwork.
rows.acceptance: Every released glyph maps to official source URL, master, size, hash and modification notice. Include license; exclude test fixtures.

rows.toolbox: THMINIT discovers/sorts themes; THMLD loads selected palette and resolution assets. Four theme families are packaged.
rows.aerodeck: Three accent choices on one flat dark/sky/ground palette; no selectable full contrast themes.
dependencies: Palette/theme configuration and state color semantics
rows.userImpact: Functional contrast/theme choice is only partially replaced; exact textures remain optional.
rows.acceptance: Offer usable contrast palettes across all screens and states. Carbon/leather/wood decorative matching is not required.

rows.toolbox: UI_THM_OV enables full-resolution overlay. With overlay off, UITSKRUN draws frames.
rows.aerodeck: Current UI uses flat native geometry and no full-screen decorative overlay.
rows.userImpact: Decorative identity can differ if every function remains clear.
rows.acceptance: Preserve AERODECK identity and legibility; do not count absence of a Toolbox texture as a functional gap.

rows.toolbox: AHR rails use RCF(...BLACK,12), header bands use 5. Native rectangle argument 6 is four-bit opacity.
rows.aerodeck: Flat rails and plates use opaque rectangle fills.
rows.userImpact: Do not assume Toolbox rails are opaque when calculating visible field area.
rows.acceptance: Real-estate comparisons must account for actual opacity and readable content; do not turn geometry into an unsupported superiority percentage.

rows.toolbox: T.i caches masks; AHR creates local drawing closures during draw, and module switching reloads tasks.
rows.aerodeck: Glyph geometry, controls and table rows are cached; some cockpit helper closures and Power button descriptors are created during drawing.
dependencies: Actual Lua heap/GC and target hardware
rows.userImpact: Both allocate; source allocation counts alone are not a benchmark.
rows.acceptance: Measure heap trend, GC stalls and worst frame cost on the same hardware; reuse hot-loop objects when it removes a measured issue.

rows.toolbox: UIML clears old task state, loads the next module and collects. Overlay is lazy-cached per module.
rows.aerodeck: One full app retains closures/icon masks. changePage clears asset/background state and collects; cached masks survive page switches.
rows.userImpact: Lifecycle differences affect cold switches, warm frame cost and ceiling.
rows.acceptance: Profile cold switches, ten-minute warm use and repeated page cycles. No growing heap, asset failure or progressive delay on actual 2.12.4.

rows.feature: Measured text fitting and long values

rows.userImpact: Normal images do not prove long names or extreme data fit every screen.
rows.acceptance: Native stress each field with long/wide/negative values, names, missing data and warnings. Measure before fitting and expose full detail when selected. Do not claim overlap without a reproduced image.

rows.acceptance: Verify all 12 screens, physical inputs, fonts, telemetry and asset paths on the TX 16 S. Synthetic 3.0 WASM is additional evidence, not target proof.

rows.toolbox: Package has distinct 480×320 layouts, graphics and all four theme-resolution directories.

rows.toolbox: Tool and full-screen WG entry modes are present. Original widget background guard tests APP.initDone, while M returns{G,F,D,X} and sets G.initDone; reachability of that hidden/background path is not proven.

rows.userImpact: Entry forms exist, but source presence must not be inflated into proven background behavior.
rows.acceptance: Verify real launch/exit/background/model change/resume on target radio. Confirm no compact/background MSP traffic and no duplicate state. Independently implement the required lifecycle rather than reproducing an unproven guard.

rows.toolbox: Original widget loader requires a full-screen APP layout; a non-fullscreen zone draws the title and Select APP mode layout, not compact telemetry cards.

dependencies: Saved per-model mappings and current samples
rows.userImpact: Useful compact telemetry is an AERODECK addition rather than missing Toolbox parity. Performance and lifecycle still require separate verification.
rows.acceptance: Verify standard zones, fonts, units, freshness, model switching and background CPU/memory alongside other widgets on actual radio.

rows.toolbox: RDKEY has multiple physical/virtual key fallbacks. MAIN/RD records radio, firmware, color and resolution.
rows.aerodeck: Current app uses virtual keys plus guarded SYS/MENU and a touch/rotary contract for the primary target.

rows.userImpact: Supporting a resolution alone does not cover a radio family.
rows.acceptance: Publish and test radio×resolution×firmware×touch/key coverage, including physical keys, fonts and Bitmap APIs. Do not claim OpenTX without evidence.

rows.toolbox: Original package and user observation prove capability presence, not every hardware condition.
rows.aerodeck: POWER-LIVE has 22 exact-source 480×272 synthetic AOS 5 screenshots from EdgeTX 3.0 WASM. Target is 2.12.4; hardware pose/performance/widget verification flags remain false.

rows.userImpact: Synthetic desktop rendering cannot certify complete hardware replacement.
rows.acceptance: Bind exact build, model and RF settings to real currentness, pose, sustained latency, physical input and widget results. Never ship fixture code/settings.

rows.toolbox: FCD provides a scrollable Firmware/FC panel: firmware name/version, API, target name and Betaflight manufacturer ID when supported.
rows.aerodeck: Diagnostics shows FC firmware version and API plus EdgeTX/build/model; no FC target/manufacturer identity.
rows.userImpact: Support and target identification are incomplete even though version/API are present.
rows.acceptance: Read and display actual FC name, target/manufacturer and version fields with capability gating and safe string bounds; distinguish missing from unsupported.

rows.toolbox: FCD defines gyroscope, accelerometer, magnetometer, barometer, GPS, sonar and pitot states, with ACTIVE/UNAVAILABLE/UNHEALTHY labels. Conditional backend support must be verified.
rows.aerodeck: No FC hardware sensor-health list; Tools/Sensors lists EdgeTX telemetry sources, which is a different concept.
rows.userImpact: A discovered radio telemetry source does not establish that its underlying FC sensor is healthy.
rows.acceptance: Independently expose FC-reported sensor present/active/health states where supported; label unknown explicitly. Do not derive hardware health from stale telemetry or arming flags alone.

rows.acceptance: All five profiles are reachable by touch/rotary, selection survives verified save/reopen, and remaining charge follows the selected capacity. Missing consumption must not fabricate full battery.

rows.userImpact: Coordinate(0,0) is accepted; no satellite-only fix claim.
rows.acceptance: Exercise equator/prime-meridian, boundaries, malformed tables, stale and missing coordinates.

rows.toolbox: TBS FC_BF/FC_IN decode FM text plus mode/arm semantics.
rows.aerodeck: Displays current FM string directly and uses BF disarm markers only for MSP eligibility.
rows.userImpact: Raw mode text exists; complete per-FC normalized mode/armed-state interpretation does not.
rows.acceptance: Decode each supported FC/protocol mode form with separate raw, display and arm state, preserving explicit unknown.

rows.toolbox: Reference keeps ALT_BARO/Alt separate from ALT_GPS/GAlt.
rows.aerodeck: One d.alt slot tries GAlt then Alt; cannot show simultaneous independent altitudes.
rows.userImpact: A barometric fallback can occupy the GPS-related altitude channel and provenance is lost.
rows.acceptance: With both sensors present show separate named values; with one missing never relabel the other as GPS.

rows.feature: Conditional accelerometer modules / disabled runtime registration
rows.toolbox: FRS/TBS ACC modules define X/Y/Z readers, but TLMINIT registers them only when MDL_ACC_ON is true. Supplied initialization/save force it off and its selector is hidden; no reachable bypass or active producer was found.
rows.aerodeck: No three-axis acceleration fields. This is not scored as a proven accessible Toolbox feature gap.
rows.userImpact: Module presence alone would incorrectly inflate parity requirements. Keep actual source availability and consumer reachability open.
rows.acceptance: Prove an accessible producer/registration path before treating measured acceleration as required parity. If implemented as an addition, use real axis sources and units, never fabricated vectors.

rows.toolbox: FRS RL registers RxBt as receiver voltage; FRS BTV uses VFAS for pack and A1/A2/A3/A4 separately.
rows.aerodeck: Auto pack-voltage aliases prioritize RxBt before VFAS; no separate receiver-voltage channel.
rows.userImpact: On FrSky a live receiver supply can be mistaken for the flight pack.
rows.acceptance: A FrSky fixture containing RxBt5V and VFAS22.8V displays them separately and applies pack alarms only toVFAS.

rows.toolbox: FRS BTA source is Fuel.
rows.aerodeck: Auto consumed source is Capa only; named manual Fuel mapping can read a numeric source but is not automatic protocol support.
rows.userImpact: Default FrSky consumption/remaining calculations can stay empty.
rows.acceptance: FRS profile reads Fuel automatically and retains Capa for CRSF; manual override remains possible.

rows.toolbox: FRS BTV defines three auxiliary voltage sources.
rows.aerodeck: No semantic auxiliary battery channels; generic inspector can show definitions only.
rows.userImpact: Multiple receiver/auxiliary supplies are lost from the functional dashboard model.
rows.acceptance: Keep three independent current voltage channels/units and make them available to telemetry/dashboard selection.

rows.toolbox: FRS BTV registers A4 cell voltage in addition to derived pack-average channel.
rows.aerodeck: Only pack/configured-cell average is used.
rows.userImpact: Measured cell voltage and derived average are not interchangeable.
rows.acceptance: Expose directly reported A4 as measured cell value with explicit provenance; never label derived average as individual cell.

rows.toolbox: FRS R9 registers R9PW and formats mW/W according to magnitude.
rows.aerodeck: Power reader uses TPWR only; no power-source mapping or R9 formatter.
rows.userImpact: R9 power can remain unavailable despite being reported.
rows.acceptance: R9 fixture reads R9PW and displays consistent mW/W without altering RF power.

rows.toolbox: FRS BF gyro registers5230/5240 and correction function with pitch inversion/divisor.
rows.aerodeck: Default reads Ptch/Roll and accepts degree/radian units; numeric FrSky status encoding is not decoded.
rows.userImpact: FrSky BF attitude is not equivalent to CRSF simply by selecting its profile.
rows.acceptance: Native FrSky5230/5240 fixtures produce correct signed degrees without renamed/calculated radio sensors.

rows.toolbox: Reference selected favourite supplies configured cells; automatic fallback differs.
rows.aerodeck: Manual0–12S and five favourites1–12S feed average/alarm calculations.
rows.userImpact: Manual and ordinary pack counts work, but reference favourite range extends to99.
rows.acceptance: Configured cells take precedence and no cells produces no invented average/alarms; support/document complete required ranges.

rows.toolbox: Original BTCNO infers1–6S from pack voltage/configured maximum when no favourite is selected.
rows.aerodeck: Manual count0 means no average/alarms; no automatic inference.
rows.userImpact: Reopening with only pack voltage does not identify cells as Toolbox can.
rows.acceptance: Offer explicit Auto/Manual mode, reproduce bounded inference as a labelled estimate and test discharged-pack ambiguity.

rows.toolbox: Reference divides pack by inferred/selected cells.
rows.aerodeck: Divides current pack voltage by configured/favourite cells and labels AVG CELL.
rows.userImpact: This is an average, never proof of individual cell measurements.
rows.acceptance: Known pack/cells yield average; missing pack/cells stays--.

rows.toolbox: Reference BTC renderer supports BT_MD_CELLS_V/BT_MD_CELL_V, but CRSF producer was not found in the provided TBS modules.
rows.aerodeck: No cell-array producer/view.
rows.userImpact: A screenshot or renderer does not establish that native CRSF supplies cell-by-cell data.
rows.acceptance: Find/prove a real supported producer and fixture; then expose individual measured cells only for that capability.

rows.toolbox: Original CFGBFV has five triples; a dashboard chooser selects a favourite.
rows.aerodeck: Five cells/capacity profiles and active selector are persisted.
rows.userImpact: The old three-slot gap is now closed for slot count/arithmetic.
rows.acceptance: Save/reopen all five slots without changing the first three saved values.

rows.toolbox: Reference favourite kind0=OFF with LiPo/LiIon chooser labels; kind controls visibility/availability.
rows.aerodeck: Every profile has only cells/capacity; no enable or chemistry.
rows.userImpact: Five rows alone do not provide the whole favourite model.
rows.acceptance: Persist per-slot enabled state and chemistry, preserve existing five values, filter quick choices accordingly.

rows.toolbox: Reference capacity100–100000mAh and cells1–99.
rows.aerodeck: Capacity100–30000mAh and cells1–12.
rows.userImpact: Larger supported batteries cannot be configured equivalently.
rows.acceptance: Define/support the full required numeric ranges and validate formatting/overflow/persistence at limits.

rows.toolbox: Original BFV dashboard builds favourite choices and updates selected cells/capacity.
rows.aerodeck: Selection requires Setup category editing/Save; no dashboard chooser.
rows.userImpact: Changing packs is a multi-step configuration workflow.
rows.acceptance: A deliberate quick choice changes only active profile, identifies the selected pack and updates derived values immediately.

rows.toolbox: Original TBS BTA overrides remaining percentage from favourite capacity minus consumed charge.
rows.aerodeck: POWER-LIVE profile overrides Bat% only with current numeric Capa; estimate is marked.
rows.userImpact: Capacity arithmetic is now present while missing Capa cannot invent a full pack.
rows.acceptance: With Bat%91/Capa300/capacity1500 show estimated80%; valid0Capa100%; staleCapa retains reported percentage.

rows.toolbox: Underlying favourite subtraction exists; explicit remaining-mAh UI display is not established in Toolbox.
rows.aerodeck: Shows max(0,capacity-consumption), compact mAh/Ah, only with current consumption.
rows.userImpact: Useful additional derived value, not an independent fuel measurement.
rows.acceptance: No selected capacity/current consumption gives no remaining-mAh value; partial-charge assumptions are explicit.

rows.toolbox: TBS BTA registers Bat% and only favourite logic overrides it.
rows.aerodeck: Current Bat% is used without valid profile consumption; profile exit clears derived state.
rows.userImpact: A saved profile does not force a fabricated100% when consumption is absent.
rows.acceptance: Test profile on/off, stale/missing consumption and valid reported0%.

rows.toolbox: Reference SNV can normalize cell voltage across min/max independent of remaining charge.
rows.aerodeck: Battery bar uses reported or capacity-estimated percentage only.
rows.userImpact: Voltage-range percentage and capacity remaining are different quantities.
rows.acceptance: Expose labelled gauge source/mode where required; do not silently present voltage normalization as charge remaining.

rows.toolbox: Original BTA changes units/precision above1000mAh.
rows.aerodeck: Power uses mAh/Ah; Flight consumed rail and fixed table keep raw mAh.
rows.userImpact: Power is compact; other displays can show truncated/small large values.
rows.acceptance: Consistent measured formatting retains value/unit in every active surface and tests all magnitude boundaries.

rows.toolbox: Reference audited native battery modules do not establish a V×A dashboard watts function.
rows.aerodeck: Current chart heading displays V×A only when both current values exist; real0A yields0W.
rows.userImpact: This closes no proven Toolbox gap and must not inflate parity totals.
rows.acceptance: Test both live, validzero, one missing and one stale; no fabricated watts.

rows.toolbox: Reference seeded BT config uses min3.0/max4.3/no-power2.7/crit3.4/low3.6, sound+critical by default; DATAINIT fallback max4.2 differs.
rows.aerodeck: Defaults min3.0/max4.2/no-power2.7/crit3.4/low3.6, visual-only; saved preferences are independent.
rows.userImpact: Defaults and enabled audible behavior differ even though category labels match.
rows.acceptance: Document/migrate deliberate defaults and compare threshold boundaries against saved policy; do not change user values silently.

rows.toolbox: CFGBAT dynamically constrains and adjusts neighboring thresholds on edit.
rows.aerodeck: Strict order is validated at Save; no automatic neighbor adjustment.
rows.userImpact: Invalid drafts are possible until save; the workflow is different but can remain safe.
rows.acceptance: Preserve monotonic limits and clearly reject/repair invalid drafts without silently applying them.

rows.toolbox: Reference warning checks are gated by enabled battery/current cell>no-power and visually normalized state.
rows.aerodeck: Current voltage plus known cells produces NO PACK/BELOW MIN/CRITICAL/LOW/ABOVE MAX; sound suppressed at no-power.
rows.userImpact: Unknown cells suppresses alarms; missing raw voltage is not an alarmed zero.
rows.acceptance: Every exact/around boundary, float32full-pack and no-cells/missing-voltage case is tested.

rows.toolbox: RD/SND implements visual-only, sound, haptic and combined policies.
rows.aerodeck: Four matching broad alert modes call tone/haptic while app runs.
rows.userImpact: Broad output modes exist; waveform/cadence differ separately.
rows.acceptance: Each selected output mode triggers only its configured output and never writes FC/model settings.

rows.toolbox: Reference BT_CELL_WARN_SND selects critical-only or critical+low.
rows.aerodeck: Audible alerts setting gates low versus critical.
rows.userImpact: Low-voltage sound is independently controlled.
rows.acceptance: Test low/critical transitions and exact boundaries under every output/audible policy.

rows.toolbox: Original quick menu toggles D.UI.mute and scheduler suppresses alert outputs.
rows.aerodeck: No temporary mute action or muted indicator.
rows.userImpact: Muting requires changing saved alert preferences or exiting the app.
rows.acceptance: Visible session mute toggles outputs immediately, preserves saved policy and has documented reset/reopen behavior.

rows.toolbox: Original MAIN/ML tick windows repeat critical/low on4s/6s cycles; RD/SND has distinct tone/haptic patterns.
rows.aerodeck: One shared >=10s timestamp, same tone/haptic pattern for all warning levels.
rows.userImpact: AERODECK does not match repeated severity cues or fast critical escalation.
rows.acceptance: Use explicit tested severity cadence/mute/transition rules without audio floods or hidden runtime writes.

rows.toolbox: Original quick Reset Flight Data resets native sensors0–63, timer, telemetry/GPS/VTX models.
rows.aerodeck: Refresh only rebinds sources; no native reset/new-flight action or consumption reset.
rows.userImpact: Old Capa/extrema/session data may carry across flights until reset outside AERODECK.
rows.acceptance: A deliberate reset with defined scope clears the intended session/native extrema and never impersonates an FC reset.

rows.toolbox: Reference RD/BAT reads tx-voltage and getGeneralSettings battMin/battMax separately.
rows.aerodeck: No transmitter-battery measurement or rail.
rows.userImpact: Quad pack telemetry does not tell the pilot radio-battery condition.
rows.acceptance: Show distinct radio supply/limits independent of receiver/quad telemetry.

rows.toolbox: Original TLMRLD ELRS RSSI-94/-102,LQ20/10; XF/Tracer RSSI-94/-102,LQ80/70; ACCST/R9 RSSI40/30 percent.
rows.aerodeck: One fixed RSSI-95/-105dBm,LQ80/60,SNR0/-5 for all profiles.
rows.userImpact: Identical physical links can classify differently; FrSky percent RSSI can be labelled dBm.
rows.acceptance: Select version-aware defaults/units with explicit user override migration and threshold tests.

rows.toolbox: Original RL maps Crossfire/Tracer/ELRS2/3 IDs to textual rates (including dynamic/full-resolution modes).
rows.aerodeck: Shows raw RFMD integer; no version-aware caption.
rows.userImpact: RFMD3 is less useful and may mean different rates across versions.
rows.acceptance: Versioned mapping displays rate name and unknown raw ID safely; no RF configuration writes.

rows.toolbox: Original TBS RL main/1 uses max(RX_RSI_CH1,RX_RSI_CH2) when second RSSI exists and is negative, otherwise falls back to the first.
rows.aerodeck: d.rssi is1RSS only by Auto;2RSS is table data, no diversity selection for main warning/rail.
rows.userImpact: A valid stronger second antenna does not affect the default main RSSI warning.
rows.acceptance: Specify per-antenna/best/selected policy, handle unavailable or invalid antenna independently and label it.

rows.toolbox: Reference Tele switch globally gates updates and keeps last native values.
rows.aerodeck: Each source is current-only; d.ok is true if any selected major source is current, so stale RF fields can coexist with live battery/GPS.
rows.userImpact: A generic no-current warning is not a dedicated RC-loss state.
rows.acceptance: Expose RF current/lost separately from overall telemetry availability and never infer a safe control link from a live non-RF sensor.

rows.toolbox: Reference INDUPD handles registered switches and arbitrary sources; configuration supports logical switches1–64 and throttle limiter sources.
rows.aerodeck: Only radio Arm/Cut indicators; physical SA–SH and logicalL01–L04, numeric threshold±300.
rows.userImpact: Throttle-limit and wider logical/source indicators are absent.
rows.acceptance: Expose every required indicator input family/range and explicitly distinguish radio command indicators from FC state.

rows.toolbox: Reference dashboard TMR reads model.getTimer for selected Timer1–3.
rows.aerodeck: No model.getTimer; local radio-arm stopwatch only.
rows.userImpact: Existing EdgeTX timers are not visible as Toolbox timers.
rows.acceptance: Read selected native Timer1–3 with correct mode/value/countdown/persistence metadata.

rows.toolbox: Original RD/TMR uses setTimer/resetTimer and arm transitions when app owns timer.
rows.aerodeck: No native timer control/reset API calls.
rows.userImpact: A local elapsed label cannot replace OS-hosted and app-hosted timer modes.
rows.acceptance: Explicit ownership mode starts/stops/resets only the selected timer; preserves unrelated timer settings and supports reset/armed semantics.

rows.toolbox: Reference native timer persists according to OS timer host/persistent settings.
rows.aerodeck: Local stopwatch depends on radioArm, clamps each elapsed callback gap to1s, stops when full app stops, no reset/persistence.
rows.userImpact: Long callback pauses or leaving full screen undercounts elapsed time.
rows.acceptance: Define session clock ownership and test multi-second pauses, app hide/reopen, arm transitions and reset without equating it to FC flight time.

rows.toolbox: Original TBS GPS computes POS_FIX from sat threshold and synthetic HDOP from sat count; not a receiver-reported3D fix.
rows.aerodeck: FIX TYPE NOT REPORTED; no fake constellation or HDOP.
rows.userImpact: A screenshot3D FIX is not proof of real fix data; visual copying would regress accuracy.
rows.acceptance: Preserve honest unknown until an actual supported status source is decoded; label estimates explicitly rather than as3D fix.

rows.toolbox: Original FRS GPS_BF decodes Tmp2 digits into GPS status/fix/satellites; home distance0420 is a separate source.
rows.aerodeck: Only Sats numeric name and GPS table; no Tmp2 decoder.
rows.userImpact: FrSky BF can lose actual status even if coordinates exist.
rows.acceptance: Fixture each documented Tmp2 encoding and map fix/count independently; missing must remain unknown.

rows.toolbox: Original FRS GPS_IN uses0480 status,0420distance,0450ground course,0460home azimuth.
rows.aerodeck: No corresponding numeric field readers/bit decode.
rows.userImpact: INAV actual home/fix information is not replaced by AERODECK local math.
rows.acceptance: Decode native INAV field encodings with exact fixtures; keep FC home separate from local captured home.

rows.toolbox: Original GPS module displays satellite type/id/status/used/CN signal from MSP164-decoded records, including gated display paths.
rows.aerodeck: No satellite records, only count; CRSF client requests2/1/3/150.
rows.userImpact: Per-satellite GPS/Glonass/Galileo/etc data is absent, not merely hidden UI.
rows.acceptance: Read supported satellite records under bounded scheduling; display real type/id/used/status/signal and explicit unsupported state.

rows.toolbox: Original TBS GPS locks local home after fix-threshold AND armed state; before lock it updates candidates.
rows.aerodeck: Manual capture or optional first position with sats>=homeSats; no arm condition and no actual-fix input.
rows.userImpact: Home may be a preflight/late-page position instead of takeoff home.
rows.acceptance: Choose explicit Manual/armed-fix/first-valid policies and test transitions without claiming local home is FC home.

rows.toolbox: Reference GPS uFN is invoked from telemetry update model, independent of current GPS drawing page.
rows.aerodeck: navSnapshot is called only by navigation/GPSDetails renderers.
rows.userImpact: Staying on Flight can delay home and omit most flight track samples.
rows.acceptance: Capture home and bounded positions from a shared update model while Flight/Power/other pages remain visible.

rows.toolbox: Reference GPSINIT provides great-circle distance/course/bearing.
rows.aerodeck: geo computes Earth-radius6371000 haversine distance and bearing with range-validated coordinates.
rows.userImpact: Equivalent local navigation math exists; source/ownership semantics remain separate.
rows.acceptance: Test zero distance, dateline, poles, north/east cardinal examples and invalid coordinates.

rows.toolbox: FRS/INAV can consume FC0420/0460; TBS home is app-local capture.
rows.aerodeck: All home coordinates/distances are app-local only and labelled so.
rows.userImpact: Full replacement needs each supported provenance, not one universalHOME value.
rows.acceptance: Represent FC-home and local-home separately with source/freshness and unsupported states.

rows.toolbox: Reference calcBearing compares current ground course to home azimuth.
rows.aerodeck: Absolute bearing-to-home exists; no separate relative bearing numeric/model value.
rows.userImpact: A pilot-facing relative turn indication is incomplete.
rows.acceptance: Show relative angle with wrap, zero-speed/unknown-course handling and clearly labelled absolute bearing.

rows.toolbox: Reference calcTravelTime converts distance/speed units and returns h/m/s.
rows.aerodeck: No ETA/travel-time calculation/display.
rows.userImpact: Distance alone omits the reference time-to-home utility.
rows.acceptance: Compute labelled constant-speed estimate, handle zero/missing speed and unit conversions without infinities.

rows.toolbox: Original GPSINIT provides encodeToPlusCode function (recovered tables damaged).
rows.aerodeck: No plus-code encoder.
rows.userImpact: Location sharing/compact recovery code capability is missing even if seldom shown.
rows.acceptance: Use an independently implemented standard codec with known vectors; do not reuse damaged recovered code.

rows.toolbox: Reference posLog records date,time,ostime; configured bounded history, enabled/disabled mode.
rows.aerodeck: Track records lat/lon only at~1Hz on GPS pages,10–180 points.
rows.userImpact: No time metadata, duration, speed-over-trail or equivalent log controls.
rows.acceptance: Shared bounded history includes timestamps and explicit retention/reset semantics; distinguish RAM history from SD flight logging.

rows.toolbox: Reference Reset Flight Data queues GPSINIT and sensor resets.
rows.aerodeck: SET LOCAL HOME clears track; source mapping/Refresh does not invalidate existing home/track and no new-flight action exists.
rows.userImpact: A changed GPS source or new flight can retain an unrelated old home.
rows.acceptance: Increment source/session generation and reset or require recapture when relevant source/session changes; preserve unrelated settings.

rows.toolbox: Reference app-mode widget loads the same M implementation and routes refresh/events.
rows.aerodeck: Fullscreen loads same telem.lua and routes run/event/touch.
rows.userImpact: Core app use as fullscreen widget exists.
rows.acceptance: Exercise fullscreen enter/exit/failure and all physical/touch controls with the same live telemetry model.

rows.toolbox: Reference loader shows Select APP mode layout outside full-radio size; compact instrument mode is not established.
rows.aerodeck: Compact voltage/LQ/current display exists, using qualified/current numeric sources and None.
rows.userImpact: This is additional functionality; do not count it as proof of reference parity.
rows.acceptance: Validate small/large zone layouts and current/stale/zero/manual/None cases in actual native widget runtime.

rows.toolbox: Original loader has background→ML.bg but guards APP.initDone; M returns{G,F,D,X} and sets G.initDone. Reachability is not established.
rows.aerodeck: Compact/background explicitly stops and destroys full app; MSP/alerts/session state stop.
rows.userImpact: Do not claim reference hidden alarms/timers work merely because a callback exists. AERODECK definitely stops them.
rows.acceptance: Resolve reference lifecycle or test it; define required background model and verify no duplicate polling/query consumers.

rows.toolbox: Reference app widget retains APP object; actual hidden callback caveat remains.
rows.aerodeck: Compact→fullscreen constructs app; returning destroys it. No persistent shared trace/home/timer/alarm session service.
rows.userImpact: Home/track/timers cannot be treated as one continuous widget session.
rows.acceptance: Define single session owner across compact/fullscreen/tool and explicit hidden behavior; avoid duplicate alerts/MSP.

rows.toolbox: Reference TLMSADD caches source IDs.
rows.aerodeck: Compact read calls expensive qualified getSourceIndex for voltage/LQ/current every refresh and allocates alias tables.
rows.userImpact: Full-app positive caching does not prove compact performance; repeated source lookup remains.
rows.acceptance: Cache positive compact IDs and bound recovery/refresh; measure native callback cost without changing current/None semantics.

rows.toolbox: Reference has Reload ToolBox and queued config/data reinit.
rows.aerodeck: Full app loads preferences at init; compact mappings reload only when model name/update changes, not when another surface saves settings.
rows.userImpact: Saved source mappings can stay stale in an existing compact widget until lifecycle reset.
rows.acceptance: Notify/version shared settings on explicit save/reload; test concurrent visible widget instances without implicit preference writes.

rows.toolbox: Reference MSP scheduler is a queued subsystem; other agent audits commands/arbitration.
rows.aerodeck: One pending request, max4 telemetry pops/callback, max256payload; unrelated frame types are popped then ignored. No global consumer arbitration.
rows.userImpact: Bounded local work exists; overlapping CRSF scripts may still consume each others replies.
rows.acceptance: Explicitly define exclusive/shared ownership, cancellation and queue handoff; test actual tool/widget lifecycle rather than increasing drain rate.

rows.toolbox: Reference calls telemetry/model updates then UI modules; native performance not measured here.
rows.aerodeck: Attitude polled before redraw limiter and again in sample; drawing target5–30Hz is not telemetry sample rate.
rows.userImpact: A responsive callback loop is present; mock100Hz does not prove radio attitude freshness/FPS.
rows.acceptance: Preserve native IDs/pitch sign and measure sustained real sensor-change rate separately from draw rate.

rows.toolbox: Reference widget ML has getUsage-based reinit yielding/progress queue.
rows.aerodeck: Startup synchronously scans configuration/units/native sensors (up to3×64) and initializes modules; no instruction-budget yield/progress.
rows.userImpact: Cold startup cost is bounded but not cooperatively scheduled like reference reinit.
rows.acceptance: Measure target runtime instruction/callback budget and split only the necessary expensive initialization while preserving valid states.

rows.toolbox: Reference GF provides full collect passes and memory monitoring; exact performance effect unknown.
rows.aerodeck: Full collect at page changes and cold icon loads/widget app destruction; no explicit full collect in normal warm Flight draw.
rows.userImpact: Navigation/cold-load stalls remain possible; source does not establish a leak or actual hardware improvement.
rows.acceptance: Measure cold/warm/page transitions/heap recovery on target firmware and avoid forced collections inside steady attitude work.

rows.toolbox: Reference GPS history uses configurable cap; telemetry arrays are registered sensor lists.
rows.aerodeck: Trace capped90; track capped10–180; byte parser max256; source caches grow with distinct attempted mappings until refresh.
rows.userImpact: Common collections are bounded by source/history use, but sustained heap behavior is unmeasured.
rows.acceptance: Soak repeated source/profile/page changes, assert collection caps and no monotonically retained objects after lifecycle resets.

rows.toolbox: Reference Reset Flight Data resets source/session data.
rows.aerodeck: Traces reset only if d.mode changes; mode stays1, so source/profile refresh can retain old source history under a new caption.
rows.userImpact: A chart can mix old and newly selected sensor histories.
rows.acceptance: Tag traces by source/session identity and reset or visibly segment on a relevant mapping/session change.

rows.feature: Diagnostic error-log file / defective reference toggle
rows.toolbox: FSLOG appends queued diagnostics to lua_log.txt. Original CFGAPP uses APP_errLog but runtime/serialization use APP_LOG_ERR; numeric0 remains truthy in the consumer. A working user opt-in toggle is not proven.
rows.aerodeck: Metrics/transport counters are RAM-only; no optional persistent error log.
rows.userImpact: A reboot/crash can lose diagnostic context. This is not flight-data logging.
rows.acceptance: Provide explicit bounded opt-in error logs with safe write schedule/failure handling; never reinstate uncontrolled per-frame logging.

rows.toolbox: Reference GPS posLog is RAM; audited FSLOG is diagnostic text, not proof of full flight CSV logging.
rows.aerodeck: No automatic runtime telemetry SD logging; RAM charts only.
rows.userImpact: Do not invent a missing Toolbox flight-logger feature without finding its writer.
rows.acceptance: Search/prove actual reference export/writer before adding a parity requirement; optional new logging remains separately scoped.

rows.toolbox: Reference configuration writer persists application data; full corruption policy requires separate config audit.
rows.aerodeck: Battery/settings Save writes/verifies backup then new file; startup tries main,bak,defaults. No atomic rename transaction.
rows.userImpact: Verified saves and fallback exist; interrupted second writes are mitigated by backup, not proven atomicity.
rows.acceptance: Inject failed open/write/readback/truncation and restart; retain last valid preferences and clearly report save failure.

rows.toolbox: Reference declares expected power units/ranges; no universal power-unit conversion or finite-value guard established.
rows.aerodeck: Voltage/current/Capa/% readers accept any current numeric unit and NaN/Infinity; motion readers validate selected unit kinds.
rows.userImpact: A wrongly mapped mA source can read asA; invalid numerics may reach formatting/alarms. This is a robustness gap, not proven lost Toolbox conversion.
rows.acceptance: Validate finite numerics and expected compatible units at the adapter boundary; convert only supported units and report INVALID otherwise.

rows.toolbox: Reference reinit can reload protocol/model readers.
rows.aerodeck: Missing-name retry can bind new FM, but fcLink.native is detected only in init and not refreshed by refreshBindings.
rows.userImpact: A newly created CRSF FM sensor may need reopening before MSP can activate, despite refreshed data bindings.
rows.acceptance: Explicit refresh reconciles capability metadata once without adding repeated enumeration or requests.

rows.toolbox: Reference GF loader asserts missing function/module conditions; no complete fault isolation established.
rows.aerodeck: loadScript chunk/factory calls are unprotected; missing transport handled as MODULE UNAVAILABLE but bad module execution can abort app.
rows.userImpact: Missing and corrupt/throwing modules are different failure cases.
rows.acceptance: Inject missing, invalid, throwing and wrong-shape modules; retain a navigable explicit error state or document firmware termination.

rows.toolbox: Reference has sensor reset/timer writes plus MSP/VTX/FS writes (separate transport/config ledger).
rows.aerodeck: Native values are read through source APIs. Filesystem writes are app settings/backups; uplink packets use FC read commands and consume shared CRSF queues/link bandwidth. No model/FC/RF setting writes are present.
rows.userImpact: Read-only behavior is not full replacement of required state-changing functions; future implementations need explicit scope/ownership.
rows.acceptance: Trace each action to intended setting/timer/sensor/FC operation; verify unrelated model/RF/output settings remain unchanged.

rows.toolbox: No comparable reference automated suite was established from the provided package.
rows.aerodeck: 13 portable suites cover protocol, source/config/layout/navigation/pitch/icons/power;12000 callback simulation proves bounded mock work only.
rows.userImpact: Existing tests are meaningful but do not prove every missing protocol/widget/session feature or real radio performance.
rows.acceptance: Maintain behavior-level tests per atomic requirement; distinguish mock scheduling from firmware and physical data rates.

rows.toolbox: Reference screenshots and user experience exist; no fresh controlled cross-product native comparison in this audit.
